subject: VM evidence, SIG Q&A and priority SLA commitments
messages:
From: Timothy Cross <tim.cross@acme-payments.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Acme Payments Security <security@acme-payments.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG VM evidence + SLA commitments for upcoming audit

Olga,

Thanks for taking this. Acme's compliance team is preparing for a SIG assessment next month and we need to collect vulnerability management evidence for Redwood. Specifically we need:

- Proof of authenticated network and authenticated scanning cadence for infrastructure (last 12 months)
- Snapshot(s) from your vulnerability scanner showing inventory and open/closed CVE lists (we need at least the most recent scan: 2026-08-31)
- A clear SLA statement for CVE remediation windows by severity (P1/P2/P3 equivalent) and any documented exception process
- A short attestation letter on Redwood letterhead confirming you will remediate critical CVEs within the stated SLA and that you maintain forensic/retention logs for scan results for at least 12 months

Can you confirm you can supply a compact evidence bundle and a signed attestation by 2026-09-12? If you can, please include file names so we can point our SIG reviewer at the right artifacts.

Thanks,
Tim Cross
Security Program Manager
Acme Payments

[Attachment: SIG-ask-template.xlsx (xlsx) referenced for what the assessor will expect]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Timothy Cross <tim.cross@acme-payments.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG VM evidence + SLA commitments for upcoming audit

Tim —

Appreciate the heads up. We can provide a compact proofpack and a formal attestation. Plan below: 

1) Evidence bundle (one zip with indexed files) — will include: scan snapshots (last 3 scans), CVE remediation log exported from our tracker, scan cadence summary, and ownership matrix.
2) SLA statement — publish a short table (Critical: 7 days, High: 30 days, Medium: 90 days) and an escalation matrix for exceptions.
3) Attestation PDF on Redwood letterhead and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

We have a small exception process for third-party kernel/backport issues; those are documented in the remediation log and highlighted in the package.

Ben — can you assemble the scan snapshots and CVE export (CSV) from the tracker and drop them in a shared Drive folder?
Soojin — can you draft the attestation text and SLA table?

Will target delivery EOD 2026-09-12 and will surface early artifacts by end of day tomorrow (2026-09-11).

Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: none at this step; internal checklist referenced]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG VM evidence + SLA commitments for upcoming audit

Team —

Uploaded the artifacts to the shared drive: folder 'Acme_VM_Evidence_2026-09-11'. Contents (high level):
- scan-snapshot-2026-08-31.pdf (scanner: Tenable)
- scan-snapshot-2026-06-30.pdf
- scan-snapshot-2026-04-30.pdf
- cve-remediation-log-2026-09-10.csv (fields: cve, component, severity, owner, opened_at, resolved_at, comment)
- rdw_vm_proofpack_v1.zip (index.html pointing to the above PDFs/CSVs and a short README)

Notes: the remediation CSV includes a 'route-to-exception' column where we flagged 3 kernel backports (vendor-locked) and included mitigation controls. I also added a short 'scan cadence' table in the README that shows authenticated weekly scans for infra and daily container image scans for images in our registry.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme/VulnerabilityEvidence/rdw_vm_proofpack_v1.zip

I will also export a small summary (cve-remediation-summary.txt) that maps P1/P2/P3 to Redwood's internal SLA buckets.

Ben
Ben Carter
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: rdw_vm_proofpack_v1.zip, scan-snapshot-2026-08-31.pdf, cve-remediation-log-2026-09-10.csv]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Timothy Cross <tim.cross@acme-payments.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG VM evidence + SLA commitments for upcoming audit

Tim,

Draft attestation and SLA table attached. Short summary here: 

- Critical (CRITICAL / CVSS >=9): remediation target 7 calendar days from detection/triage; emergency patch lanes and 24/7 on-call escalation.
- High (CVSS 7-8.9): remediation target 30 calendar days.
- Medium/Low: remediation target 90 calendar days for medium, tracked for low.
- Exceptions: documented and routed through security exceptions board; any exception includes compensating controls and a defined mitigation timeline.

We included the signed-by block for Redwood's VP of Security (Laura Bennett). Once you confirm the attestation language is acceptable I'll drop an attestation PDF and route the DocuSign link.

Attached: olga_attestation_draft.txt, sla_table_20260912.csv

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: olga_attestation_draft.txt, sla_table_20260912.csv]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Timothy Cross <tim.cross@acme-payments.com>, Acme Payments Security <security@acme-payments.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG VM evidence + SLA commitments for upcoming audit

Tim/Karen —

Thanks for the quick review and for flagging timing. Per our commitments above: the evidence bundle is live in the shared Drive and the attestation has been executed. Links below.

Delivered items:
- rdw_vm_proofpack_v1.zip (index) — https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme/VulnerabilityEvidence/rdw_vm_proofpack_v1.zip
- scan-snapshot-2026-08-31.pdf (Tenable scan export)
- cve-remediation-log-2026-09-10.csv (export from our remediation tracker)
- olga_attestation_acme_20260912.pdf (signed by Laura Bennett, VP Security) — attached and sent via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/instance/ABC123DEF456

We included a short 'remediation runway' in the attestation describing our P1/P2/P3 windows and the exception process for vendor-locked fixes. If the assessor needs any additional mapping (e.g., mapping your internal severity to our buckets) Ben can produce a crosswalk CSV quickly.

If you want a one-page cover note summarizing the package for your SIG reviewer, I can produce that and email it directly to the assessor.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: olga_attestation_acme_20260912.pdf (pdf) — attestation signed; rdw_vm_proofpack_v1.zip referenced above]
